summary: The Hubbard County 'Itasca' record matches no source by name; the likeliest lead is the 1913 Arago tower near Itasca State Park, unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Identity unresolved. The record's Itasca (Hubbard, 47.24802, -95.16864, gone) has no entry under that name in the 2025 compilation or in the Hubbard-only survey list at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/36/Hubbard_County_Towers.pdf. The Forest Fire Lookout Association's Hubbard list has an Itasca entry and no Arago; the compilation's Hubbard list has an Arago entry and no Itasca. By elimination the closest candidate is the Arago tower (1913, height 75 in the Hubbard-only list's table; no coordinates given anywhere). Nothing in the sources ties the two names together. A human should decide whether this record is the Arago tower, a duplicate, or a different structure, or find a source with coordinates. Not to be confused with us-mn-itasca-state-park (Clearwater County, 47.23909, -95.19615), which the compilation identifies as the Itasca Ranger Station tower (state tower 67, 47.2390, -95.1962). No staffing, fire, build-date or site facts for this record were found, so the story gives none. No corrections proposed: the record may be right and only unidentified.
